About the job

As a Corporate Sales Executive at Keraology, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth and expanding our client base. Your English proficiency, both spoken and written, will be key in effectively communicating with potential clients. Proficiency in MS-Office and MS-Excel will also be crucial in managing sales data and creating compelling presentations.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve sales targets.
2. Identify new business opportunities and build strong relationships with potential clients.
3. Conduct market research to understand customer needs and trends.
4. Prepare and present sales proposals and negotiate contracts.
5. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop promotional materials.
6. Track sales performance and provide regular reports to management.
7. Stay up to date on industry trends and competitor activities to stay ahead of the competition.

If you are a motivated sales professional with excellent communication skills and a passion for driving business growth, we invite you to join our dynamic team at Keraology. Take your career to the next level with us!

About Keraology

Website
Keraology Products has a UV protectant, color-treated formula. It forms a breathable barrier over the hair strand, allowing nutrients to penetrate the hair shaft while blocking harmful UV rays and locking in color molecules. Its gentle and great for high lift blonds with damaged hair needing delicate attention due to over processing. It's also great for fast fading redheads, creative colors, and color repigmentation to keep colors vibrant longer. Keraology products contains a unique SBT shield technology, that includes Sea Buckthorn Berry Oil and a vitaplex, to protect hair against premature fading and sun damage while delivering moisture, vitamins, and powerful antioxidants for color that wows!
